issue.title: Athena root hourly cron executes bryan-writable scripts
issue.description: Move root-executed entrypoints and every sourced helper/interpreter dependency into a root-owned, non-user-writable installation, or run jobs unprivileged where their requirements permit. Preserve backup and hourly-job behavior. Review current source through sase_repo before reading another repository; use sase_sudo for installation and privileged validation. The root cause is the writable execution chain, so changing only symlink ownership is insufficient. Distinct from bob-cli-8u (supervisor/multivisor RPC and its venv) and canceled bob-cli-1a (rsync exit-24 handling); related follow-ups should not be reopened or silently expanded. Size medium: bounded migration of two cron entrypoint chains, with known ownership defect.

task_type_fields.impact: A compromise of the bryan account can become root through hourly cron without a sudo prompt.
task_type_fields.repro: On athena, ls -l /etc/cron.hourly/hourly_jobs /etc/cron.hourly/hourly_backup shows root cron entries symlinked into /home/bryan/db/bin/cron.jobs/cron.hourly/. stat -Lc "%U:%G %a %n" on both returns bryan:bryan 755 (2026-10-18 landing recheck). Root cron therefore executes code Bryan can replace.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-8v.1 note #3 and independently confirmed during epic landing; a pre-existing user-to-root execution path is outside the apt/Plex changes.

payload.description: Both remove pre-existing bryan-to-root execution paths; cron entrypoint ownership is separate from supervisor RPC and venv ownership
The hourly backup entrypoint is shared, but ownership migration is distinct from the canceled rsync exit-status report
Closeout recheck of status and notes

payload.entry: bob-cli-an.2 evidence: pre-change verifier (tailnet hosts/athena/root-cron/verify_root_cron.py run as bryan) exits 1 with both hourly entrypoints resolving into the bryan-owned tree and bryan-writeable; live schedule and outputs healthy (run-parts lists both, exporter and hourly marker fresh, newest rotation root-owned). Hardened root-owned payload staged for install via reviewed sase sudo gate; install/rollback mechanics and scratch backup+collector runs validated without privilege. Close decision belongs to the epic lander after privileged verification lands.

Validation from phase bob-cli-an.2 (2026-10-22): root hourly cron hardened and live-verified — install+verify 46/46, schedule lists both jobs, exercise EXERCISE_OK via TOO_SOON guard, verify-after 46/46, live files byte-identical to tailnet hosts/athena/root-cron, exporter and backup marker fresh; task left open for land agent.

payload.description: Same writable root-cron chain defect; bob-cli-96 (phase bob-cli-an.2) fixed only the hourly entries and provides the tailnet installer/verifier pattern to extend

payload.entry: Lander bob-cli-an.land verified live on athena 2026-10-23: /etc/cron.hourly/hourly_jobs and hourly_backup are regular root:root 0755 files, and /usr/local/lib/athena-cron is root:root 0755. All are byte-identical (cmp) to tailnet dbb7368 hosts/athena/root-cron. Phase bob-cli-an.2 gates recorded install and verify at 46/46 with bryan and nobody denial probes, plus EXERCISE_OK. Hourly rotations keep landing as root (latest 04:24 today) under the pre-existing rsync exit-24 discard pattern, so bob-cli-1a was reopened with +1 evidence. The same writable shape remains in the daily, weekly, and monthly root cron entries, now tracked as bob-cli-au.
